section_path_text: MMI Daily Iron Ore Index Report October 15 2026
summary:
Main
Prices softened broadly again, with yesterday's recovery in some seaborne brands failing to continue.DCE most-traded fell to 671.5 yuan/mt, while the 61%, 58% and 65% port indices were 654, 615 and 813 yuan/wmt. The seaborne 61% index was USD 88.80/dmt and the 65% was 107.50, with all 12 brands declining. The port high low spread narrowed to 198 yuan/wmt as the composite high-grade index came under greater pressure this period.
